how
on oxenhead, the companion runs in the service of my python runtime, from its start, speaking ble through able; tangling this note puts it there.
  • how: it speaks the bumble companion’s protocol, and saves the recording as /sdcard/Recordings/twatch/<time>.wav.
  • how: once the recording is saved, it writes SAVED and stays linked for the next; when it loses the watch, or bluetooth comes back on, android’s STATE_ON, it looks for it again.
    • why: on STATE_ON, able does not yet take a scan, « BLE adapter is not enabled »; it waits ADAPTER_WAIT_S first.
  • how: it looks for the watch by its name, which android allows while the phone’s screen is off.
    • rule: below android 12, as oxenhead’s 8.1, the phone’s location must be on, battery-saving mode enough: without it a scan finds nothing and says nothing.
  • how: it closes any link it still holds before linking anew.
    • why: bluetooth switched off sends no unlink, and able refuses a new link while the old one is open.
    • how: closing gives able a fresh queue of writes.
      • why: able sends each write once the last one is answered; a write lost with the link is never answered, its timeout needs a ticking kivy clock the service lacks, so every later link hung on its packet size and its notifications.
  • how: when the watch is not ready SEARCH_AGAIN_S after it began looking, it drops its scan and any half-made link, and looks again.
    • how: before looking again it pauses, SCAN_PAUSE_S after the first miss, twice longer after each next one, at most SCAN_PAUSE_MAX_S; finding the watch starts the pauses anew.
      • therefore: a watch away for hours costs the phone a scan only part of the time.
    • why: on 24/10, after a deploy reset the watch, mojito found it again only once the app was restarted.
  • how: before looking for the watch, it takes the one android may still hold linked from before a restart, which does not advertise while it believes itself linked.
  • how: once connected, it asks for packets of 247 bytes, and learns the watch’s service on the answer, or after 2 s without one, as when android hands it a link already set up.
  • how: from a recording’s first packet to its saving, it asks android for its fast link, CONNECTION_PRIORITY_HIGH, and back to the low-power one after.
  • how: once linked, it asks android for its low-power link, CONNECTION_PRIORITY_LOW_POWER, through the gatt able’s dispatcher holds.
  • how: once it knows the service, it writes one thing at a time, each on the last one’s answer: both notifications, the time, READY with the phone’s bluetooth name; only then the recalls and the REPL

relay.

  • how: a step android refuses, or answers with a failure, is said; one left unanswered STEP_WAIT_S is sent again, and after STEP_TRIES the link is dropped and looked for anew.
  • why: on 24/10 mojito twice linked, found the services, and never heard back on the voice notifications, so the link hung before « ready ».
  • how: a recall is queued when the service is told so, as by clk android -d oxenhead remote call "twatch:recall?text=call the dentist&priority=4&expires=2", its priority 3 and its life 1 h when not told, stamped with the minute it came.
  • how: each notification the app’s listener broadcasts becomes a recall, worded as the desk companion words it, « Signal: Alice: on my way »; ongoing ones, as a player, and the app’s own are left out, but for a ringing call: a « call » of high importance, sent at priority 6, buzzing until it stops ringing.
    • how: once android’s call state leaves « RINGING », answered or ended, a recall of priority 0 tells the watch to stop.
    • how: android’s importance sets its priority: high or more, 3, a buzz; default, 2, shown in silence; low and min are left out, as android shows them in silence too.
    • how: a « navigation » one, as OsmAnd’s « 75 m • Tournez à gauche », goes through whatever its importance, as « 75 m Tournez a gauche », lit in silence, with a buzz when the turn after « • » changes; it lives a minute.
      • what: OsmAnd posts it twice, one ongoing; a title already sent is not sent again.
    • how: a player’s « transport » one, its title and text, goes at priority 7, for the media row, each time it changes; it lives a minute.
  • how: a media command the watch notifies on MEDIA drives the first of android’s active media sessions, which the app’s notification listener may reach: back, play or pause by its state, skip.
    • how: that session’s title and artist go at priority 7 at each link and a second after each command, empty when none plays.
      • why: Cromite never posts its media notification again as it plays on.
    • how: a 9 rings the phone’s alarm, looping at full volume, until a 10, the screen turning on or off, or a minute; the alarm’s volume is then put back.
      • how: the alarm is a beep of its own, a quarter second of 2.7 kHz at full scale then a quarter second of silence, written once as /sdcard/poc/twatch_beep.wav and played on the alarm’s stream.
        • why: on 26/10 mojito’s default alarm named a file gone, and the first one android listed played 15 s in silence.
        • why: « same remark for phone »: Alarm_Beep_01.ogg at full volume was too low; a phone’s speaker, as the watch’s, is loudest in the kHz.
      • how: it answers the watch with a recall, « phone ringing », or « phone silent: » and why.
        • why: « must have message to indicate it got my tap »
  • how: « twatch:ring », as the Twatch screen’s « ring watch » button sends it, queues a recall of priority 8, « find me », living a minute: the watch beeps and buzzes till its wheel is pressed.
    • why: « watch buzzed but did not ring »; a call’s priority 6 keeps buzzing only.
    • how: while it rings the button reads « stop », and a second « twatch:ring » sends the 0.
      • why: « the “ring watch” must become “stop” »
    • how: the button turns back on the stop, on the watch’s 11 after its wheel press, or after the minute; the screen asks « twatch:is_ringing » when it opens.
  • how: the queue is written on RECALL one at a time, at each link and each new recall; one leaves it only once the watch took it, or once expired, which is said.
  • how: at each link, it gives the watch the phone’s local time, as android’s calendar knows it, its sunday first turned into the watch’s monday first.
  • how: it keeps its last 50 lines, sends each new one to the app, and gives them all on « twatch:lines ».
    • how: each new line also becomes the text of an ongoing notification of its own, on a « twatch » channel of low importance: shown, never heard.
      • why: on 26/10 mojito showed no notification of the app at all, foreground service or not.
      • why: « need a background notif on phone to know what’s going on »
  • how: it relays tcp port 9721 to the watch’s REPL: what comes in is written on REPL_IN, one packet at a time, and what the watch notifies on REPL_OUT goes back out.
    • how: on each new client, it first stops the watch’s main.py and drops 2 s of what the watch says, before relaying anything.
    • how: a client cut off mid-way ends its relay only; the next one is served.
    • how: while a client is served, the link is the fast one, the low-power one again after.
      • why: each of the REPL’s round trips waits a connection interval: a 4.9 KB file took 79 s on the low-power link.
  • how: « twatch:picture », given a picture’s path, shows it on the watch: the whole picture, shrunk into the 240x208 band between the hour and the bar, centred on black, goes as the 416 half-rows the watch takes on PICTURE, one write at a time, on the fast link, the low-power one again after.
    • why: « not fit in screen », of a wide picture whose middle square only was sent.
    • how: each write waits for no answer from the watch, only for android to take it.
      • why: « very slow »: 480 writes each waiting the watch’s answer took 17 s.
    • how: android packs each pixel as RGB565 little-endian; its two bytes are swapped for the st7789.
    • how: REPL packets go first when both wait.
    • how: once the desktop leaves, the relay says how many bytes went to the watch, came back, still wait, and whether a write is left unanswered.
      • why: « never work aroud, always fix. If not clear, add logs to improve knowledge »: linked, the watch gave no REPL byte at 14:14.
    • how: once the desktop leaves, the bytes still waiting are dropped, never sent at the next link.
      • what: sent there, they reach the watch’s REPL as keys, and a Ctrl-C among them stops its main.py.
  • how: each line the watch sends on ERRORS is said as « watch error: … », its notifications asked for before READY.
    • why: « log excep(ions somewhere boot resistant and at next lçnk send to phone and purge »
  • how: each line on CHARGE is said as « watch charge: … », its notifications asked for the same way; untested, no story running phone code.
    • why: « 2 »: the charge kept apart from the errors.
  • how: a 12 from the watch refuses the ringing call, through android’s telecom service.
    • how: its answer, « call refused » or why not, goes back to the watch as a lit, silent recall, priority 2, dropped after 6 min.
      • why: « the preqs to hangoff must have more feedvack »
    • how: it needs android 9 or later and the ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS permission; a refusal is said.
  • how: once an hour has passed, the next line it says is followed by its own cost since the last count: its process’s cpu seconds, its scans and their time, and its time linked to the watch.
    • why: « this must be captured in the poc app itself, not via the desktop »
    • what: its own mAh is out of reach: android gives it only with BATTERY_STATS, which apps do not get18.
    • how: no timer of its own, so the count costs no wake; untested, no story running phone code.
  • how: every 5 min it appends a line to /sdcard/poc/twatch_record.csv: the time, the battery’s percent, what plugs it, whether the screen is on, the link’s state, and the links made and lost since.
    • why: « oxenhead PoC must autonomously record relevant data that we will analyse later »
    • how: a plain timer, no alarm: asleep, the phone writes nothing, and the gap in the times tells it.
    • scope: untested, no story running phone code.

import math
import socket
import struct
import threading
import time
from collections import deque
from logging import getLogger
from pathlib import Path

from able import GATT_SUCCESS, BluetoothDispatcher
from able.filters import DeviceNameFilter
from android.broadcast import BroadcastReceiver
from helpers.osc import oschandler, to_app
from jnius import autoclass

NAME = "twatch"
NOTIFICATION = "eu.konubinix.konixpoc.NOTIFICATION"
PHONE_STATE = "android.intent.action.PHONE_STATE"
VOICE = "8d5a7819-0002-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
READY = "8d5a7819-0003-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
RECALL = "8d5a7819-0004-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
SAVED = "8d5a7819-0005-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
REPL_IN = "8d5a7819-0006-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
REPL_OUT = "8d5a7819-0007-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
TIME = "8d5a7819-0008-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
MEDIA = "8d5a7819-0009-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
PICTURE = "8d5a7819-000a-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
ERRORS = "8d5a7819-000c-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
CHARGE = "8d5a7819-000d-4b5a-a8f2-6f7a6c1b0e01"
SIDE = 240
BAND = 208
HALF_ROW = 242
WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE = 1
LISTENER = "eu.konubinix.konixpoc.NotificationForwarder"
PLAYING = 3
MEDIA_SETTLE_S = 1
FIND_PHONE = 9
PHONE_FOUND = 10
WATCH_FOUND = 11
REFUSE_CALL = 12
SHOWN_LIT = 2
ANSWER_EXPIRES_H = 0.1
FIND_ME = 8
FIND_FOR_S = 60
NOTIFY_CHANNEL = "twatch"
NOTIFY_ID = 9721
IMPORTANCE_LOW = 2
SCREEN_ON = "android.intent.action.SCREEN_ON"
SCREEN_OFF = "android.intent.action.SCREEN_OFF"
STREAM_ALARM = 4
USAGE_ALARM = 4
BEEP = Path("/sdcard/poc/twatch_beep.wav")
BEEP_HZ = 2700
BEEP_RATE = 16000
INBOX = Path("/sdcard/Recordings/twatch")
RELAY_PORT = 9721
DRAIN_S = 2
HIGH = 1
LOW_POWER = 2
ADAPTER_ON = 12
ADAPTER_WAIT_S = 2
MTU_WAIT_S = 2
SEARCH_AGAIN_S = 300
SCAN_PAUSE_S = 30
SCAN_PAUSE_MAX_S = 300
COST_EVERY_S = 3600
RECORD = Path("/sdcard/poc/twatch_record.csv")
RECORD_EVERY_S = 300
STEP_WAIT_S = 5
STEP_TRIES = 2
GATT_PROFILE = 7
IMPORTANCE_NONE = 0
IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT = 3
IMPORTANCE_HIGH = 4
Calendar = autoclass("java.util.Calendar")

logger = getLogger(__name__)


class Companion(BluetoothDispatcher):
    def __init__(self, say):
        super().__init__()
        self._say = say
        self.cost_at = time.monotonic()
        self.cpu_at = time.process_time()
        self.scans = 0
        self.scan_s = 0
        self.scan_since = None
        self.linked_s = 0
        self.linked_since = None
        self.received = bytearray()
        self.mtu = 23
        self.recall = None
        self.discovering = False
        self.recalls = deque()
        self.recalling = None
        self.repl_in = None
        self.picture = None
        self.steps = deque()
        self.to_watch = deque()
        self.pieces = deque()
        self.writing = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.desktop = None
        self.draining = False
        self.repl_sent = 0
        self.repl_back = 0
        self.search = 0
        self.misses = 0
        self.step = None
        self.step_id = 0
        self.step_tries = 0
        self.made = 0
        self.lost = 0

    def say(self, line):
        self._say(line)
        self.note_cost()

    def note_cost(self):
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - self.cost_at < COST_EVERY_S:
            return
        cpu = time.process_time()
        scan_s = self.scan_s + (0 if self.scan_since is None else now - self.scan_since)
        linked_s = self.linked_s + (0 if self.linked_since is None else now - self.linked_since)
        self._say("cost over {:.1f} h: cpu {:.0f} s, scan {:.0f} s in {} scans, linked {:.0f} s".format(
            (now - self.cost_at) / 3600, cpu - self.cpu_at, scan_s, self.scans, linked_s))
        self.cost_at, self.cpu_at, self.scans, self.scan_s, self.linked_s = now, cpu, 0, 0, 0
        self.scan_since = None if self.scan_since is None else now
        self.linked_since = None if self.linked_since is None else now

    def start_scan(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.scan_since is None:
            self.scans += 1
            self.scan_since = time.monotonic()
        super().start_scan(*args, **kwargs)

    def stop_scan(self):
        if self.scan_since is not None:
            self.scan_s += time.monotonic() - self.scan_since
            self.scan_since = None
        super().stop_scan()

    def linked(self, now_linked):
        if now_linked and self.linked_since is None:
            self.linked_since = time.monotonic()
            self.made += 1
        elif not now_linked and self.linked_since is not None:
            self.linked_s += time.monotonic() - self.linked_since
            self.linked_since = None
            self.lost += 1

    def receive_one(self):
        self.received = bytearray()
        self.linking = False
        with self.lock:
            self.search += 1
            search = self.search
        threading.Timer(SEARCH_AGAIN_S, self.search_again, (search,)).start()
        watch = connected_watch()
        if watch is not None:
            self.on_device(watch, None, None)
            return
        link_state("looking for the watch")
        self.say("looking for the watch")
        self.start_scan(filters=[DeviceNameFilter(NAME)])

    def close_gatt(self):
        super().close_gatt()
        self._set_queue()

    def search_again(self, search):
        with self.lock:
            if search != self.search:
                return
        pause = min(SCAN_PAUSE_S * 2 ** self.misses, SCAN_PAUSE_MAX_S)
        self.misses += 1
        self.say("not back after {} s, searching again in {} s".format(SEARCH_AGAIN_S, pause))
        self.stop_scan()
        self.close_gatt()
        link_state("watch away")
        threading.Timer(pause, self.resume_search, (search,)).start()

    def resume_search(self, search):
        with self.lock:
            if search != self.search:
                return
        self.receive_one()

    def on_bluetooth_adapter_state_change(self, state):
        link_state(_state)
        if state == ADAPTER_ON:
            self.say("bluetooth back")
            threading.Timer(ADAPTER_WAIT_S, self.receive_one).start()

    def on_device(self, device, rssi, advertisement):
        if device.getName() == NAME and not self.linking:
            self.linking = True
            self.misses = 0
            self.stop_scan()
            self.say("linking")
            self.close_gatt()
            self.connect_gatt(device)

    def on_connection_state_change(self, status, state):
        self.linked(status == GATT_SUCCESS and state)
        if status == GATT_SUCCESS and state:
            self.discovering = False
            self.request_mtu(247)
            threading.Timer(MTU_WAIT_S, self.discover, ("no packet size answer",)).start()
        else:
            link_state("watch unlinked")
            self.say("unlinked")
            with self.lock:
                self.recall = self.recalling = self.repl_in = self.picture = None
                self.pieces.clear()
                self.writing = False
                self.step_id += 1
            self.steps.clear()
            self.close_gatt()
            self.receive_one()

    def on_mtu_changed(self, mtu, status):
        self.mtu = mtu
        self.discover("linked, packets of {} bytes".format(mtu))

    def discover(self, why):
        with self.lock:
            if self.discovering:
                return
            self.discovering = True
        self.say(why)
        self.discover_services()

    def on_services(self, status, services):
        self.voice = services.search(VOICE)
        self.saved = services.search(SAVED)
        self.services = services
        self.gatt.requestConnectionPriority(LOW_POWER)
        self.steps = deque([
            ("voice notifications", lambda: self.enable_notifications(self.voice)),
            ("REPL notifications", lambda: self.enable_notifications(services.search(REPL_OUT))),
            ("time", lambda: self.write_characteristic(services.search(TIME), local_time())),
            ("ready", lambda: self.write_characteristic(services.search(READY), phone_name())),
        ])
        if services.search(MEDIA) is not None:
            self.steps.insert(2, ("media notifications",
                                  lambda: self.enable_notifications(services.search(MEDIA))))
        if services.search(ERRORS) is not None:
            self.steps.insert(2, ("error notifications",
                                  lambda: self.enable_notifications(services.search(ERRORS))))
        if services.search(CHARGE) is not None:
            self.steps.insert(2, ("charge notifications",
                                  lambda: self.enable_notifications(services.search(CHARGE))))
        self.next_step()

    def next_step(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.step_id += 1
        if self.steps:
            self.step = self.steps.popleft()
            self.step_tries = 0
            self.run_step()
            return
        link_state("watch linked")
        self.say("ready")
        with self.lock:
            self.search += 1
            self.recall = self.services.search(RECALL)
            self.repl_in = self.services.search(REPL_IN)
            self.picture = self.services.search(PICTURE)
            if self.picture is not None:
                self.picture.setWriteType(WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE)
        threading.Thread(target=show_playing, daemon=True).start()
        self.send_recalls()
        self.pump()

    def run_step(self):
        name, call = self.step
        self.step_tries += 1
        with self.lock:
            step_id = self.step_id
        if call() is False:
            self.say("android refused {}".format(name))
        threading.Timer(STEP_WAIT_S, self.step_unanswered, (step_id,)).start()

    def step_unanswered(self, step_id):
        with self.lock:
            if step_id != self.step_id:
                return
        name = self.step[0]
        if self.step_tries < STEP_TRIES:
            self.say("no answer to {}, again".format(name))
            self.run_step()
            return
        self.say("no answer to {}, dropping the link".format(name))
        with self.lock:
            self.step_id += 1
        self.steps.clear()
        self.close_gatt()
        self.receive_one()

    def answered(self, status):
        if status != GATT_SUCCESS:
            self.say("{} answered {}".format(self.step[0], status))
        self.next_step()

    def on_descriptor_write(self, descriptor, status):
        self.answered(status)

    def on_characteristic_changed(self, characteristic):
        if characteristic.getUuid().toString() == REPL_OUT:
            self.repl_back += len(characteristic.getValue())
            if self.desktop is not None and not self.draining:
                try:
                    self.desktop.sendall(bytes(b % 256 for b in characteristic.getValue()))
                except OSError as error:
                    self.say("relay cut: {}".format(error))
            return
        if characteristic.getUuid().toString() == MEDIA:
            code = characteristic.getValue()[0] % 256
            if code == REFUSE_CALL:
                self.queue_recall(refuse_call(self.say), SHOWN_LIT, ANSWER_EXPIRES_H)
                return
            media_command(code, self.say)
            return
        if characteristic.getUuid().toString() == ERRORS:
            line = bytes(b % 256 for b in characteristic.getValue()).decode(errors="replace")
            self.say("watch error: {}".format(line))
            return
        if characteristic.getUuid().toString() == CHARGE:
            line = bytes(b % 256 for b in characteristic.getValue()).decode(errors="replace")
            self.say("watch charge: {}".format(line))
            return
        if not self.received:
            self.gatt.requestConnectionPriority(HIGH)
        self.received.extend(b % 256 for b in characteristic.getValue())
        if len(self.received) < 4:
            return
        (length,) = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.received)
        if len(self.received) - 4 >= length:
            INBOX.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path = INBOX / time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.wav")
            path.write_bytes(bytes(self.received[4:4 + length]))
            self.say("saved {}".format(path))
            self.received = bytearray()
            self.gatt.requestConnectionPriority(LOW_POWER)
            self.write_characteristic(self.saved, b"\x01")

    def on_characteristic_write(self, characteristic, status):
        if characteristic.getUuid().toString() == SAVED:
            self.say("told the watch")
        elif characteristic.getUuid().toString() in (TIME, READY):
            self.answered(status)
        elif characteristic.getUuid().toString() in (REPL_IN, PICTURE):
            with self.lock:
                self.writing = False
            self.pump()
        elif characteristic.getUuid().toString() == RECALL:
            with self.lock:
                sent, self.recalling = self.recalling, None
                if status == GATT_SUCCESS and self.recalls and self.recalls[0] is sent:
                    self.recalls.popleft()
            if status == GATT_SUCCESS and sent is not None:
                self.say("recall given: {}".format(sent["text"]))
            self.send_recalls()

    def queue_recall(self, text, priority, expires_h):
        with self.lock:
            self.recalls.append({"text": text, "priority": priority, "sent": local_minute(),
                                 "expires": time.time() + expires_h * 3600})
        self.say("recall queued, priority {}: {}".format(priority, text))
        self.send_recalls()

    def send_recalls(self):
        with self.lock:
            while self.recalls and self.recalls[0]["expires"] < time.time():
                self.say("recall expired: {}".format(self.recalls.popleft()["text"]))
            if self.recall is None or self.recalling is not None or not self.recalls:
                return
            self.recalling = self.recalls[0]
            payload = struct.pack("<BHBBBB", self.recalling["priority"], *self.recalling["sent"])
            payload += self.recalling["text"].encode()
            recall = self.recall
        try:
            self.write_characteristic(recall, payload)
        except Exception as error:
            self.say("recall kept for the next link: {}".format(error))
            with self.lock:
                self.recalling = None

    def relay(self, data):
        step = self.mtu - 3
        with self.lock:
            self.to_watch.extend(data[i:i + step] for i in range(0, len(data), step))
        self.pump()

    def show_picture(self, pieces):
        with self.lock:
            if self.picture is None:
                self.say("no picture: the watch is not linked")
                return
            if self.mtu - 3 < HALF_ROW:
                self.say("no picture: packets of {} bytes, {} needed".format(self.mtu, HALF_ROW + 3))
                return
            self.pieces.clear()
            self.pieces.extend(pieces)
        self.say("sending a picture")
        self.prioritize(HIGH)
        self.pump()

    def pump(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.writing:
                return
            if self.to_watch and self.repl_in is not None:
                target, chunk = self.repl_in, self.to_watch.popleft()
                self.repl_sent += len(chunk)
            elif self.pieces and self.picture is not None:
                target, chunk = self.picture, self.pieces.popleft()
                last = not self.pieces
            else:
                return
            self.writing = True
        self.write_characteristic(target, chunk)
        if target is self.picture and last:
            self.say("picture sent")
            if self.desktop is None:
                self.prioritize(LOW_POWER)

    def serve_relay(self):
        server = socket.socket()
        server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        server.bind(("0.0.0.0", RELAY_PORT))
        server.listen(1)
        while True:
            self.desktop, address = server.accept()
            self.repl_sent = self.repl_back = 0
            self.say("relaying the REPL for {}".format(address[0]))
            self.prioritize(HIGH)
            self.draining = True
            self.relay(b"\r\x03\x03")
            time.sleep(DRAIN_S)
            self.draining = False
            try:
                while True:
                    data = self.desktop.recv(1024)
                    if not data:
                        break
                    self.relay(data)
            except OSError as error:
                self.say("relay cut: {}".format(error))
            self.desktop.close()
            self.desktop = None
            self.prioritize(LOW_POWER)
            with self.lock:
                waiting = sum(len(chunk) for chunk in self.to_watch)
                self.to_watch.clear()
                writing = self.writing
            self.say("relay closed: {} bytes to the watch, {} back, {} waiting dropped{}".format(
                self.repl_sent, self.repl_back, waiting, ", a write unanswered" if writing else ""))

    def prioritize(self, level):
        gatt = self.gatt
        if gatt is not None:
            gatt.requestConnectionPriority(level)


def local_time():
    now = Calendar.getInstance()
    return struct.pack(
        "<HBBBBBB", now.get(Calendar.YEAR), now.get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1,
        now.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH), (now.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) + 5) % 7,
        now.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY), now.get(Calendar.MINUTE), now.get(Calendar.SECOND))


def picture_pieces(path):
    # the whole picture, shrunk into the band between the hour and the bar, centred on black, as the
    # watch's 416 half-rows
    BitmapFactory = autoclass("android.graphics.BitmapFactory")
    Bitmap = autoclass("android.graphics.Bitmap")
    options = autoclass("android.graphics.BitmapFactory$Options")()
    options.inJustDecodeBounds = True
    BitmapFactory.decodeFile(path, options)
    if options.outWidth <= 0:
        raise ValueError("not a picture: {}".format(path))
    options.inJustDecodeBounds = False
    options.inSampleSize = max(1, max(options.outWidth, options.outHeight) // (2 * SIDE))
    whole = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(path, options)
    scale = min(SIDE / whole.getWidth(), BAND / whole.getHeight())
    fitted = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(whole, max(1, round(whole.getWidth() * scale)),
                                       max(1, round(whole.getHeight() * scale)), True)
    small = Bitmap.createBitmap(SIDE, BAND, autoclass("android.graphics.Bitmap$Config").RGB_565)
    canvas = autoclass("android.graphics.Canvas")(small)
    canvas.drawColor(autoclass("android.graphics.Color").BLACK)
    canvas.drawBitmap(fitted, float((SIDE - fitted.getWidth()) // 2),
                      float((BAND - fitted.getHeight()) // 2), None)
    buffer = autoclass("java.nio.ByteBuffer").allocate(SIDE * BAND * 2)
    small.copyPixelsToBuffer(buffer)
    # android keeps each pixel little-endian, the st7789 takes it big-endian
    pixels = bytearray(b % 256 for b in buffer.array())
    pixels[0::2], pixels[1::2] = pixels[1::2], pixels[0::2]
    return [bytes((y, half)) + bytes(pixels[(y * SIDE + half * SIDE // 2) * 2:][:SIDE])
            for y in range(BAND) for half in (0, 1)]


def phone_name():
    name = autoclass("android.bluetooth.BluetoothAdapter").getDefaultAdapter().getName() or ""
    return name.encode()[:20].decode("utf-8", "ignore").encode() or b"\x01"


def media_session():
    service = autoclass("org.kivy.android.PythonService").mService
    manager = service.getSystemService(autoclass("android.content.Context").MEDIA_SESSION_SERVICE)
    # jnius matches no constructor taking the service as a context; two strings it does
    listener = autoclass("android.content.ComponentName")(service.getPackageName(), LISTENER)
    sessions = manager.getActiveSessions(listener)
    return None if sessions.isEmpty() else sessions.get(0)


def alarm_sound():
    if not BEEP.exists():
        quarter = BEEP_RATE // 4
        tone = b"".join(struct.pack("<h", int(32000 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * BEEP_HZ * n / BEEP_RATE)))
                        for n in range(quarter)) + bytes(2 * quarter)
        BEEP.write_bytes(b"RIFF" + struct.pack("<I", 36 + len(tone)) + b"WAVEfmt "
                         + struct.pack("<IHHIIHH", 16, 1, 1, BEEP_RATE, 2 * BEEP_RATE, 2, 16)
                         + b"data" + struct.pack("<I", len(tone)) + tone)
    return str(BEEP)


def find_phone(say):
    try:
        ring(say)
    except Exception as error:
        say("silent: {}".format(error))
        recall("phone silent: {}".format(error), 3, expires_h=1 / 60)
        return
    say("ringing the phone")
    recall("phone ringing", 2, expires_h=1 / 60)


def ring(say):
    global _alarm, _volume, _found
    service = autoclass("org.kivy.android.PythonService").mService
    audio = service.getSystemService(autoclass("android.content.Context").AUDIO_SERVICE)
    with _alarm_lock:
        if _alarm is None:
            player = autoclass("android.media.MediaPlayer")()
            player.setAudioAttributes(
                autoclass("android.media.AudioAttributes$Builder")().setUsage(USAGE_ALARM).build())
            player.setDataSource(alarm_sound())
            player.setLooping(True)
            player.prepare()
            _volume = audio.getStreamVolume(STREAM_ALARM)
            _alarm = player
        audio.setStreamVolume(STREAM_ALARM, audio.getStreamMaxVolume(STREAM_ALARM), 0)
        _alarm.start()
        if _found is not None:
            _found.cancel()
        _found = threading.Timer(FIND_FOR_S, phone_found, (say,))
        _found.start()


def phone_found(say):
    global _alarm, _found
    with _alarm_lock:
        if _alarm is None:
            return
        _alarm.stop()
        _alarm.release()
        _alarm = None
        if _found is not None:
            _found.cancel()
            _found = None
        service = autoclass("org.kivy.android.PythonService").mService
        audio = service.getSystemService(autoclass("android.content.Context").AUDIO_SERVICE)
        audio.setStreamVolume(STREAM_ALARM, _volume, 0)
    say("phone found")


def refuse_call(say):
    # android 9 and later; the app needs ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS granted
    service = autoclass("org.kivy.android.PythonService").mService
    telecom = service.getSystemService(autoclass("android.content.Context").TELECOM_SERVICE)
    try:
        ended = telecom.endCall()
    except Exception as error:
        answer = "call not refused: {}".format(error)
    else:
        answer = "call refused" if ended else "no call to refuse"
    say(answer)
    return answer


def media_command(code, say):
    if code == FIND_PHONE:
        find_phone(say)
        return
    if code == PHONE_FOUND:
        phone_found(say)
        return
    if code == WATCH_FOUND:
        watch_quiet("watch found")
        return
    if code == REFUSE_CALL:
        refuse_call(say)
        return
    session = media_session()
    if session is None:
        say("media {}: nothing plays".format(code))
        return
    controls = session.getTransportControls()
    if code == 1:
        controls.skipToPrevious()
    elif code == 3:
        controls.skipToNext()
    elif session.getPlaybackState() is not None and session.getPlaybackState().getState() == PLAYING:
        controls.pause()
    else:
        controls.play()
    say("media {} to {}".format(code, session.getPackageName()))
    threading.Timer(MEDIA_SETTLE_S, show_playing).start()


def show_playing():
    global _played
    session = media_session()
    metadata = session and session.getMetadata()
    title = artist = None
    if metadata is not None:
        title = metadata.getString("android.media.metadata.TITLE")
        artist = metadata.getString("android.media.metadata.ARTIST")
    _played = plain(": ".join(part for part in (title, artist) if part))
    recall(_played, 7, expires_h=1 / 60)


def connected_watch():
    service = autoclass("org.kivy.android.PythonService").mService
    manager = service.getSystemService(autoclass("android.content.Context").BLUETOOTH_SERVICE)
    for device in manager.getConnectedDevices(GATT_PROFILE).toArray():
        if device.getName() == NAME:
            return device
    return None


def local_minute():
    now = Calendar.getInstance()
    return (now.get(Calendar.YEAR), now.get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1, now.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH),
            now.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY), now.get(Calendar.MINUTE))


LINES = deque(maxlen=50)
_companion = None
_notifications = None
_calls = None
_guided = None
_played = None
_screen = None
_alarm = None
_volume = None
_found = None
_alarm_lock = threading.Lock()
_ringing_watch = None
_state = "looking for the watch"


def say(text):
    logger.info("twatch: %s", text)
    line = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S ") + text
    LINES.append(line)
    to_app("twatch:log", line)
    show_in_notification(line)


def link_state(state):
    global _state
    _state = state
    show_in_notification(LINES[-1] if LINES else "")


def show_in_notification(line):
    # a notification of the twatch's own, on a low channel: shown, never heard
    String = autoclass("java.lang.String")
    try:
        enabled = autoclass("android.bluetooth.BluetoothAdapter").getDefaultAdapter().isEnabled()
        service = autoclass("org.kivy.android.PythonService").mService
        manager = service.getSystemService(autoclass("android.content.Context").NOTIFICATION_SERVICE)
        manager.createNotificationChannel(autoclass("android.app.NotificationChannel")(
            NOTIFY_CHANNEL, String("twatch"), IMPORTANCE_LOW))
        notification = (autoclass("android.app.Notification$Builder")(service, NOTIFY_CHANNEL)
                        .setSmallIcon(service.getApplicationInfo().icon)
                        .setContentTitle(String(_state if enabled else "bluetooth off"))
                        .setContentText(String(line))
                        .setOngoing(True)
                        .setOnlyAlertOnce(True)
                        .build())
        manager.notify(NOTIFY_ID, notification)
    except Exception as error:
        logger.info("twatch: notification not shown: %s", error)


@oschandler("twatch:lines", answer=True)
def lines(_):
    return list(LINES)


@oschandler("twatch:picture")
def picture(message):
    path = message.get("path") if isinstance(message, dict) else message
    try:
        pieces = picture_pieces(str(path))
    except Exception as error:
        say("no picture: {}".format(error))
        return
    _companion.show_picture(pieces)


@oschandler("twatch:ring")
def ring_watch(_):
    global _ringing_watch
    if _ringing_watch is not None:
        recall("", 0, expires_h=1 / 60)
        watch_quiet("watch stopped")
        return
    recall("find me", FIND_ME, expires_h=1 / 60)
    _ringing_watch = threading.Timer(FIND_FOR_S, watch_quiet, ("watch rang a minute",))
    _ringing_watch.start()
    to_app("twatch:ringing", True)
    say("ringing the watch")


@oschandler("twatch:is_ringing", answer=True)
def is_ringing(_):
    return _ringing_watch is not None


def watch_quiet(why):
    global _ringing_watch
    if _ringing_watch is None:
        return
    _ringing_watch.cancel()
    _ringing_watch = None
    to_app("twatch:ringing", False)
    say(why)


def start():
    global _companion, _notifications, _calls, _screen
    if _companion is None:
        _companion = Companion(say)
        _companion.receive_one()
        threading.Thread(target=_companion.serve_relay, daemon=True).start()
        _notifications = BroadcastReceiver(notified, actions=[NOTIFICATION])
        _notifications.start()
        _calls = BroadcastReceiver(call_state, actions=[PHONE_STATE])
        _calls.start()
        _screen = BroadcastReceiver(lambda context, intent: phone_found(say),
                                    actions=[SCREEN_ON, SCREEN_OFF])
        _screen.start()
        record()


def record():
    try:
        service = autoclass("org.kivy.android.PythonService").mService
        Intent = autoclass("android.content.Intent")
        battery = service.registerReceiver(None, autoclass("android.content.IntentFilter")(
            Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED))
        percent = battery.getIntExtra("level", -1) * 100 // max(1, battery.getIntExtra("scale", 100))
        power = service.getSystemService(autoclass("android.content.Context").POWER_SERVICE)
        with RECORD.open("a") as out:
            out.write("{},{},{},{},{},{},{}\n".format(
                time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), percent, battery.getIntExtra("plugged", 0),
                int(power.isInteractive()), _state, _companion.made, _companion.lost))
        _companion.made = _companion.lost = 0
    except Exception as error:
        logger.info("twatch: not recorded: %s", error)
    timer = threading.Timer(RECORD_EVERY_S, record)
    timer.daemon = True
    timer.start()


def recall(text, priority=3, expires_h=1):
    _companion.queue_recall(text, priority, expires_h)


def call_state(context, intent):
    if intent.getStringExtra("state") != "RINGING":
        # a stop that waits for a link would come too late to matter
        recall("", 0, expires_h=1 / 60)


def guided(intent):
    global _guided
    title = intent.getStringExtra("title")
    if title is None or title == _guided:
        return
    turn = title.split(" • ", 1)[-1]
    changed = _guided is None or _guided.split(" • ", 1)[-1] != turn
    _guided = title
    recall(plain(title.replace(" • ", " ")), 3 if changed else 2, expires_h=1 / 60)


def played(intent):
    global _played
    title, text = intent.getStringExtra("title"), intent.getStringExtra("text")
    shown = plain(": ".join(part for part in (title, text) if part))
    if shown != _played:
        _played = shown
        recall(shown, 7, expires_h=1 / 60)


def notified(context, intent):
    if intent.getStringExtra("category") == "navigation":
        guided(intent)
        return
    if intent.getStringExtra("category") == "transport":
        played(intent)
        return
    importance = intent.getIntExtra("importance", IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT)
    ringing = intent.getStringExtra("category") == "call" and importance >= IMPORTANCE_HIGH
    if intent.getBooleanExtra("ongoing", False) and not ringing:
        return
    if intent.getStringExtra("package") == context.getPackageName():
        return
    if IMPORTANCE_NONE <= importance < IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT:
        return
    title, text = intent.getStringExtra("title"), intent.getStringExtra("text")
    if title is None and text is None:
        return
    priority = 6 if ringing else 3 if importance >= IMPORTANCE_HIGH else 2
    recall(worded(intent.getStringExtra("app"), title, text,
                  intent.getStringExtra("package"), intent.getStringExtra("category")), priority)


import re
import unicodedata

NTFY_ADDRESS = re.compile(r"^[\w.-]+(:\d+)?/([\w-]+)$")
LEADING_TIME = re.compile(r"^\d\d:\d\d: ?")
LINK = re.compile(r"https?://([^/\s]+)\S*")
DATE_TIME = re.compile(r"\b\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d[ T](\d\d:\d\d)(:\d\d(\.\d+)?)?")


def plain(text):
    text = DATE_TIME.sub(r"\1", LINK.sub(r"\1", text))
    return " ".join("".join(_drawable(char) for char in text).split())


SPELLED = {"œ": "oe", "Œ": "OE"}


def _drawable(char):
    try:
        char.encode("cp437")
        return char
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        return SPELLED.get(char) or unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", char).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()


CALL_ICON, SMS_ICON, WHATSAPP_ICON, MAIL_ICON = "\x01\x02", "\x03\x04", "\x05\x06", "\x07\x08"
NTFY_ICON, CALENDAR_ICON = "\x0e\x0f", "\x10\x11"
PACKAGE_ICONS = {
    "com.whatsapp": WHATSAPP_ICON,
    "io.heckel.ntfy": NTFY_ICON,
    "com.google.android.apps.messaging": SMS_ICON,
    "com.android.messaging": SMS_ICON,
    "com.android.mms": SMS_ICON,
    "com.google.android.gm": MAIL_ICON,
    "com.fsck.k9": MAIL_ICON,
    "eu.faircode.email": MAIL_ICON,
}
CATEGORY_ICONS = {"call": CALL_ICON, "email": MAIL_ICON, "event": CALENDAR_ICON, "reminder": CALENDAR_ICON}


def icon(package, category):
    return PACKAGE_ICONS.get(package) or CATEGORY_ICONS.get(category)


def worded(app, title, text, package=None, category=None):
    text = LEADING_TIME.sub("", text or "")
    if app == "ntfy":
        address = NTFY_ADDRESS.match(title or "")
        title = address.group(2) if address else title
        return NTFY_ICON + plain("{}: {}".format(title, text) if title else text)
    known = icon(package, category)
    if known:
        return known + plain("{}: {}".format(title or "", text))
    return plain("{}: {}: {}".format(app, title or "", text))
how
mojito runs the same companion, sent there over ssh.
how
the stories run the same companion on the desktop, its android parts faked by the story.
how
the app’s Twatch screen has a « ring watch » button on top, sending « twatch:ring ».
how
the app’s Twatch screen shows the companion’s lines: those the service kept, asked for when it opens, then each new one; the launcher opens it on its button or the « twatch » message.
  • how: a new line waits for the app’s next turn, without the wakelock oschandler takes.
    • why: that wakelock lights the screen; one per line kept oxenhead’s lit 5 min in 21 while linked.

import json

from kivy.clock import Clock
from kivy.uix.boxlayout import BoxLayout
from kivy.uix.button import Button
from kivy.uix.label import Label
from kivy.uix.screenmanager import Screen

from helpers.osc import TimeoutException, osc, to_service

SHOWN = 50


class TwatchScreen(Screen):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.lines = []
        self.label = Label(font_size=20, halign="left", valign="bottom")
        self.label.bind(size=lambda label, size: setattr(label, "text_size", size))
        self.column = BoxLayout(orientation="vertical")
        buttons = BoxLayout(size_hint_y=None, height=120)
        self.ring = Button(text="ring watch")
        self.ring.bind(on_release=lambda _: to_service("twatch:ring"))
        buttons.add_widget(self.ring)
        self.column.add_widget(buttons)
        self.column.add_widget(self.label)
        self.add_widget(self.column)
        osc.bind("/twatch:log", lambda line: Clock.schedule_once(lambda _: self.add(json.loads(line))))
        osc.bind("/twatch:ringing",
                 lambda on: Clock.schedule_once(lambda _: self.ringing(json.loads(on))))

    def ringing(self, on):
        self.ring.text = "stop" if on else "ring watch"

    def add(self, line):
        self.lines = (self.lines + [line])[-SHOWN:]
        self.label.text = "\n".join(self.lines)

    def on_enter(self):
        self.lines = []
        try:
            kept = to_service("twatch:lines", wait_for_answer=True, timeout=5)
            self.ringing(to_service("twatch:is_ringing", wait_for_answer=True, timeout=5))
        except TimeoutException:
            kept = ["the service does not answer"]
        for line in kept:
            self.add(line)


def populate(sm):
    if not sm.has_screen("twatch"):
        sm.add_widget(TwatchScreen(name="twatch"))
how
mojito gets the same screen, sent there over ssh, so its Twatch button finds it.
how
one command puts the watch’s code on it, opens the companion on oxenhead, starts the watch, and pulls the inbox here.
  • how: clk runs outside the device shell, mpremote inside it.
  • how: a ctrl-C stops main.py but leaves it advertising, so the watch’s radio is switched off before the companion opens; the phone links only to the watch the reset starts.
import bluetooth

bluetooth.BLE().active(False)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
here=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")
port=${1:-/dev/ttyACM0}
"$here/deploy-watch.sh" "$port"
nix-shell "$here/device-shell.nix" --run "mpremote connect $port resume cp $here/watch/main.py :main.py + run $here/watch/quiet.py"
clk android -d oxenhead poc restart
clk android -d oxenhead remote wait
clk android -d oxenhead remote call twatch
nix-shell "$here/device-shell.nix" --run "mpremote connect $port resume run $here/watch/updated.py + reset" || true
sleep 90
mkdir -p "$here/inbox"
adb -s oxenhead:5555 pull /sdcard/Recordings/twatch/. "$here/inbox/"
